prompt:
Flat sumi-e ink wash painting on aged warm paper. Hand-painted, not rendered. A single isolated subject on plain paper, centred, whole subject in frame. Dark tapering brush outline, flat even ink-wash fill, uniform ambient tone with no visible light source, no cast shadow, no sheen. Monochromatic warm grey from pale paper to near-black ink. Brush character at every edge.

Subject: one long horizontal band of mist, a piece of a cloud sea, drifting across the middle of the picture. A long even band, thickest in the middle, about six times wider than it is tall. Painted with the palest wash only, barely darker than the paper, with a few slightly darker soft streaks inside it. The upper edge is soft and billowing, with no line. The lower part and both ends thin away to nothing in bare paper. There is no outline anywhere and no hard edge anywhere: this subject is all soft wash. Nothing in it is darker than a light grey. The reference image is a piece of the original painting: take the brush handling, the ink values and the paper from the cloud sea in it, but paint only the subject described here.

Plain empty aged-paper background and nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no figure, no gate, no path, no sun, no moon, no birds, no text, no seal, no border, no frame. The paper is one flat even pale tone from edge to edge, with no vignette and no dark corners. Whole subject in frame with a clear margin of bare paper all round. Strictly monochrome warm grey: no blue, no green, no brown tint.
